newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says no results from talks with Israel.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says no results from talks with Israel.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat told lawmakers in the West Bank town of Ramallah on Thursday that talks with Israel have not achieved any results and called on Palestinians to be alert for the future.

"Until yesterday night, the brothers returned from the meetings and they have not reached anything," Arafat told the Palestinian Legislative Council, referring to Israeli-PLO talks in Gaza. "Thus, we must be fully prepared...to confront all possibilities."
It was Arafat's first visit to Ramallah since Israeli-Palestinian gun battles and clashes two weeks ago in which 60 Palestinians and 15 Israeli soldiers died.
Arafat said Israeli and PLO negotiators had made no progress in talks on implementing Palestinian self-rule, which includes an Israeli troop redeployment in Hebron.
